items.text: Bring all previous reports, prescriptions and a list of current medications to every follow-up appointment.
Before a doctor visit, prepare: patient name and age, list of symptoms or concerns, current medications with dosages (as prescribed), recent test results, and any questions for the doctor.
For medical emergencies in Tamil Nadu, call 108 (EMRI ambulance service, free, available 24x7).
Keep a folder with discharge summaries, lab reports and prescription records. Bring it to every appointment.
Assign care tasks clearly: who will accompany the patient, who will collect reports, and who will follow up with the doctor.
